title: New-Unit Enrollment Allowance — Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Addenda
content:
# New-Unit Enrollment Allowance

A Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans earns a new-unit enrollment allowance according to how soon after delivery the unit is enrolled. The span is counted in calendar days, from the delivery date on the Vehicle Purchase Agreements record of the unit being enrolled (the customer's single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in delivered status) to the pricing date, the day the addendum is signed.

| Calendar days from delivery to pricing date | New-unit enrollment allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | 40.00 |
| More than 30, up to and including 90 | 20.00 |
| More than 90 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical spans)
| Span | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 30 days | 40.00 |
| 31 days | 20.00 |
| 90 days | 20.00 |
| 91 days | none |

The allowance is a dollar amount, earned once per addendum.
